title: Fork
description: Lineage record created when a new execution run starts from an existing checkpoint.

fork_id.description: Unique identifier for this fork relationship.

source_checkpoint_id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint used to initialize the new lineage.

fork_reason.description: Human- or machine-readable reason for creating the fork.

fork_kind.description: Optional machine-readable classification of the fork.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time at which the new lineage was created.

new_run_id.description: Optional identifier assigned to the newly created execution run.

target_branch.description: Optional logical branch or lineage name for the new run.
